# Payco Documentation

When installing Payco packages, always check the registry for the latest version. See the [versioning guide](https://docs.payco.test/versioning.md) before pinning one.

## Docs

- [Testing](https://docs.payco.test/testing.md): Simulate payments to test your integration.
- [API Reference](https://docs.payco.test/api.md)
- [Receive payouts](https://docs.payco.test/payouts.md): Set up your bank account to receive payouts.
